answer: Re-attestations are stored in gale and anchor lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the cipher graph. Standing lapses unless 6 peers re-attest it every 19 epochs, so holding a position needs ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 368 impostors cost 938 times the honest price and take 12 times as long to clear. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
